CODE
2.3.9. 
Publicity
The notary who has received a matrimonial agreement enters it in the central register of matrimonial agreements.
A foreign deed amending the matrimonial property regime may, if it meets the conditions for recognition in Belgium, be mentioned in the margin of a deed drawn up by a Belgian notary and attached to that deed. This formality is carried out to publicise the change and does not have the effect of rendering the change enforceable against third parties.
